integrity: Scientific proof is self-contained in RESULT.md. verify.py provides exact rational moment-identity checks and a deterministic exact counterexample; no claim of independent auditing or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem analyzes only the independent-channel homogeneous linear Ito stochastic system corresponding to equation (10) of arXiv:2608.30655v1. It makes no inference about the nonlinear community equilibrium, persistence, or stationary laws. The source-model suitability of white-noise approximation is not assessed.
title: Exact mean-square stability frontier for exchangeable stochastic competition linearizations
